title: Ginkgo Bioworks reports first quarter 2026 financial results
publisher: Ginkgo Bioworks Holdings, Inc. via U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission
excerpt: Ginkgo reported first-quarter revenue of USD 19 million, adjusted EBITDA of negative USD 42 million, USD 373 million of cash and marketable securities, and reaffirmed USD 125-150 million of 2026 cash burn.
summary: The SEC-filed issuer release supplies management's autonomous-lab strategy, divestiture context, current operating metrics, cash-burn outlook, partnerships, and non-GAAP profitability evidence.
